author: Rudeless
body:
Greetings,

idozo was banned due to a young member of my family taking ban evade measures.
His actions have prevented other family members from enjoying your server and is quite disappointing.
He will not be doing this again.  He was not using the idozo account so we are unsure how his ban caused idozo to be banned as well. Can you please unban idozo?

Thank you and sincerely,

David P Lower
